defects.title: inlineTokens rebuilds the reflink-mask preamble per call (Object.keys over all link defs), making n refs + n defs O(n^2) (measured exponent 3.0, 24s at n=13000)
defects.upstream_ref: discovered autonomously by capability.upstream-discovery (footnote_defs generator, minimized n=3250) on the live npm frontier target marked 18.0.7 (latest npm release, onboarded by capability.upstream-frontier); root cause: Lexer.inlineTokens executes the masking block (Object.keys(this.tokens.links) + reflinkSearch replace) on every call including thousands of recursive link-text calls that cannot contain reflinks - O(calls x defs) allocation churn; repair: skip the masking block when the source contains no '[' (reflinkSearch can only match text containing '['), and use a Set for the label lookup
